translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Dio Ikonium, Listra, anna Derbe
Susi siam duka' dio Ikonium le'ba' tama pa'sambajanganna to Yahudi Paulus sola Barnabas anna ma'pa'guhui diona Puang Yesus nasuhum buda to Yahudi anna taianna to Yahudi matappa'.
Sapo' to Yahudi to moka untahima tula'na indo to dua umpakeaha' tau taianna to Yahudi anna mala ungkabassii to matappa'.

Iam too anna masäe-säepi tohho Paulus sola Barnabas dio anna si untula' liu Battakada Debata sola ponno kabahaniam aka uhhannuam Puang Yesus. Anna napa'patandaammi Debata ussamba' kaheba pa'kamasena lako hupatau aka umbeem indo to dua kuasa umpadadi ma'hupa-hupa tanda anna tanda memängä-mängä.
Sapo' indo issinna kota sipengka-pengka lambi' deemmi untuhu' to Yahudi anna deem untuhu' indo dua suho.
Iya sipattuju-tujum sanaka-naka to Yahudi anna taianna to Yahudi sola pepungngu'na anna mala undahha indo suho dua anna naleba'i batu.
Sapo' tappa naissam indo to dua lambi' le'ba' muäläi kalena lako Listra anna Derbe anna ongeam senga' illaam attasa'na Likaonia.
Iya eta oom naongei umpa'pakahebaam indo Kaheba Katilallasam.
Dio Listra deem mesa muane kempo' inna susi disubungam. Indo to kempo' si anggam muokko' liu aka tä' mala mellao.
Sapo' umpehingngii duka' tula'na Paulus. Iya naitanna Paulus indo to kempo' tappa naissam naua inde tau deem kamatappasanna la mala dipabono'.
Nasuhum ma'kada Paulus napekasallei naua: “Ke'de'ko längäm!” Iya ke'de' siaham kabuä-buä anna ma'lao-laoi lako dio mai.
Tappana naita tau buda indo puha napogau' Paulus, iya sikaahhem ma'basa to Likaonia naua: “Tuhum si'dam pole' debata mehhupatau tama lino.”
Lambi' disangai Barnabas debata Zeus anna Paulus ia disangai debata Hermes anu' ia si umpalao tula'.

Pissananna sulem dio ba'ba kota sando debata Zeus buttu dio mai pa'sambajanganna dio sulibam kota umbaba sanaka-naka sapim laki dibunga-bungai la natunu sola tau buda aka maelo' menomba lako indo suho.
Sapo' tappana nahingngi Paulus sola Barnabas pattujunna indo tau buda iya ussesse'-sesse'um pohebana anna lumumpa'i tama alla'-alla'na indo tau napasindum meoli naua:

“Tettekede, aka hia' iko umpogau'? Kami' inde bassim hupatau biasakam duka', susi siangkia'! Sapo' sulekam inde la umpa'pakahebaam Kaheba Katilallasam tama alla'-alla'mua' anna malakoa' tä' umpogau' liu kaha-kaha takeguna. Sapo' la mengngolo lako hakoa' Ia Puang Allataala to tubo to umpadadi langi' sola lino, le'bo' sola ingganna issinna.
Aka yolona abana napabeba'pi Puang Allataala hupatau pantam muola pattuju penabanna.

Sapo' moi anna susi tä' siam lembe Puang Allataala umpa'patandaam maaka susi kamatandeanna. Aka tontä liu umpogau' ma'hupa-hupa kamapiaanna susinna: umpatuhum liu uham yabo mai langi'; umpakembua manappa tanangammua' ke lambi' oom wattunna; nabeem liukoa' kinande anna kamasannangam penaba.”
Sapo' moi anna susi tula'na indo to dua, saidi' siam tatä' nabela nalabai indo tau buda la untunu tunuam dio olona.

Pissananna sule dio kota Listra sanaka-naka to Yahudi buttu dio mai Antiokhia dio Pisidia anna dio mai Ikonium umpa'tula'i indo tau buda, iya iam sikanatuhu'. Napolalam ussileba'-leba'im batu Paulus anna mane nabalesoi lako sulibam kota aka nasanga matem.
Iya suleim to matappa' nalomba. Mahassanni napali' nasitingngajo-ajoi iya bangommi sule anna le'ba'i tama kota. Makale'nai le'ba'um lako Derbe solai Barnabas.
Ma'pasule lako Antiokhia Paulus sola Barnabas
Tappana dio Derbe, umpa'pakahebaam oom Kaheba Katilallasam Paulus sola Barnabas nasuhum buda tau matappa'. Puhai, ma'pasulem lako Listra mane lakoi Ikonium anna Antiokhia dio Pisidia.

Illaam indo tallu kota umpakatoto' oom penabanna ingganna to untuhu' Puang Yesus anna napakahi'di liu naua: “La tontä liukoa' too matappa' lako Puang Yesus. Anu' abana hi tia inna la buda kamapi'disam taola ke maelo'kia' tama kapahentaanna Puang Allataala.”
Anna untuhopi to la mendadi pebaba ada' Paulus sola Barnabas lako si mesa-mesa jumaa'. Puhai puasa anna ma'sambajam indo to dua, iya nabehom tama pala' limanna Puang Allataala to nakatappa'i.
Mane umpatahhu' oi pa'laoanna muolai lembäna Pisidia anna lako Pamfilia.
Puhai umpa'pakahebaam Battakada Debata dio Perga, iya le'ba'um dokko Atalia.
Mengkalao diom, ma'kappala' ma'pasule lako Antiokhia, kota naongei yolona anna uhunai dibeho tama pala' pa'kamasena Puang Allataala anna mala ungkähä pengkähängam indo to nasuppisammi temo.

Sulei lako Antiokhia untambaim ingganna to matappa' mane natulasam asanni ingganna kaha-kaha puha napadadi Puang Allataala nakähä Paulus sola Barnabas. Napa'tula'i duka' maaka susi nabukkaam lalam Puang Allataala napolalam indo tau taianna to Yahudi mala duka' matappa' lako Puang Yesus.
Masäepi tohho Paulus sola Barnabas anna ingganna to matappa' dio.
